name: Granny Ash

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Fourth Sister, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's annis hag: iron claws and teeth and a crushing hug, scaled to CR 8 with legendary actions. Drawn with the night hag's sprite at Large.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When Granny Ash fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

traits.name: Iron Teeth
traits.summary: Her teeth and nails are iron, grown in over centuries; the iron is how she knows her own.
traits.text: Granny Ash's teeth and nails are iron. A girl she has raised grows the same iron in at the gums before her thirteenth birthday, and Granny can smell it a valley away.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Iron Claws and a Bite.
actions.text: Granny Ash makes two Iron Claw attacks and one Bite attack.

actions.name: Iron Claw
actions.summary: A rake of iron nails, reach 10 ft.

actions.name: Crushing Hug
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: a hug that holds a Medium or smaller target (escape DC 15), Restrained and crushed for 2d10 + 5 each turn.
actions.text: Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15); until it gets free it is also Restrained and takes 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. Granny can hug only one creature at a time.

summary: Morgantha's own mother: a blue-grey hag twice a man's height out of the deep wood, with iron teeth, iron nails and a basket the size of a cradle. Her claws reach, her hug holds and crushes, and she rakes again whenever you think you've stepped clear.
